label: VERIFIED
extraction: Council workflow detailed steps. Step 1: Extract real question (what are we deciding, what constraints matter, what counts as success). Step 2: Gather only necessary context (relevant files/snippets/issues/metrics if codebase-specific; skip repo snippets for strategic decisions). Step 3: Form Architect position first (initial position, 3 strongest reasons, main risk). Step 4: Launch three independent voices in parallel (Skeptic: challenge framing/question assumptions/propose simplest alternative; Pragmatist: optimize for speed/simplicity/real-world execution; Critic: surface downside risk/edge cases/reasons plan could fail). Each subagent gets: decision question, compact context, strict role, no unnecessary conversation history. Step 5: Synthesize with bias guardrails (don't dismiss external view without explaining why, if external voice changed recommendation say so explicitly, always include strongest dissent, if two voices align against initial position treat as real signal, keep raw positions visible). Step 6: Present compact verdict (Consensus, Strongest dissent, Premise check, Recommendation). Persistence rule: only when decision changes durable project truth. Anti-patterns: using for code review, feeding full conversation transcript, hiding disagreement.
